_comment: EMPTIED 2026-10-17. These four rules watched south's hosts through Grafana Cloud, and have reported nothing true since the metrics cutover on 2026-10-08: nothing writes to this stack any more, so all of them sat firing on noDataState with no data to have an opinion about. They were harmless only while the notification path was broken; once it was fixed they became three false Telegram messages and a daily reminder. The playbook DELETEs the rule group when this array is empty. The rules themselves are in git history (last live at 7d7c794) and are replaced by monitoring-stack rules -- see the task vault, grafana-cloud-exit phase 2.
